title: Agent OS Recommended Extensions Catalog
description: Shape of catalog/recommended.json: optional third-party extensions agent-os can install, always with explicit user approval. Only entries in this file can be installed. Every source is pinned to an exact version or commit.

step.description: One command of a recipe. Placeholders: {home} (user home), {tmp} (a new temporary directory), {repo_path} (only in per_repo steps), {plugin_root}.

id.description: Step identifier, unique within the recipe.

description.description: What the step does, shown to the user before approval.

run.description: Exact command to run, with placeholders. Nothing else is ever run for this step.

scope.description: once = run a single time. per_repo = run once per repository: the workspace root for single, each workspace_paths value for monorepo and multi-repo.

optional.description: true = the user can leave this step out before approving. Optional steps are included unless the user deselects them.

platformSteps.description: The same recipe for each platform.

unix.description: Steps for Bash (Linux, macOS, Git Bash).

check.description: A read-only command whose output decides a condition.

expect.description: Condition the command must meet, in plain words (e.g. 'exit code 0', 'output contains 1.6.2', 'major version between 20 and 24').

requirement.description: A prerequisite checked before installing. If it is not met, the entry is not installed and the user is told why.

description.description: What is required, shown to the user.

source.description: Where the extension comes from, pinned. Never a floating version such as latest or a branch name.

type.description: git = a repository at a pinned commit. npm = a package at a pinned version.

location.description: Repository URL or npm package name.

pin.description: Full 40-character commit SHA for git, exact semver version for npm.

wrapper.description: An agent-os wrapper skill written by the installer. It tells agents how to use the extension inside the pipeline.

template.description: Template path relative to the plugin root.

version.description: Template version; a different installed version means the wrapper must be rewritten on update.

entry.description: One recommended extension and its recipe.

description.description: What it does for the pipeline.

notes.description: Risks and behaviors the user must see before approving (telemetry, side effects, language limits).

assignments.description: Skills added to agents.<agent>.skills in ~/.agent-os/defaults.json, in this order, when the entry is installed.

catalog_version.description: Version of this catalog. Bump it whenever a pin, recipe or template changes.
